_what: STAND-IN for the language model while the AMD endpoint is down. Hand-written by the developer on 2026-10-17, from general controls knowledge plus the residual report of the real-data seed run. NOT model output. Used only for the real-data demo, never in the synthetic benchmark. Every program goes through the same validator and fitter as model output; every value is found by the search.

rounds.mechanism: weather curve on a filtered outdoor temperature (outdoor delay)
rounds.targets: residual correlated with outdoor: room reacts later than a curve on raw outdoor predicts
rounds.refute: fitted time constant pinned at its lower bound, or no gain over S1

rounds.expr: where(hysteresis(T_out, lo, hi), lv + sl * T_out, OFF)
rounds.mechanism: weather curve with a summer cutoff that has hysteresis on outdoor
rounds.targets: residual by outdoor band changes sign around the warm end
rounds.refute: lo and hi collapse together, or worse than S3

rounds.mechanism: weather curve saturating at a maximum supply limit
rounds.refute: cap fitted above every supply the curve reaches in the observed range

rounds.expr: lv + sl * ema(T_out, tau) + kp * (sp - ema(T_room, tau))
rounds.mechanism: filtered weather curve with slow room compensation
rounds.targets: the PI structure ranking well in the TV room: test whether slow room feedback alone explains it

rounds.expr: where(ema(T_out, tau) < co, lv + sl * ema(T_out, tau), OFF)
rounds.mechanism: filtered weather curve with cutoff on the same filtered outdoor
rounds.targets: combine outdoor delay and summer cutoff
rounds.refute: no gain over P1 or S3
